notes.title: Dev Diary #6 + Release Date
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/cJHpDv9gRN][img]https://i.imgur.com/3lyVo1H.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Hello everyone! I would like to show you my progress on the game. In this update I managed to add employees and customers. [/h3]

[h2]Customers waiting in line [/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y7HiUXz.png[/img]


[h2]Release date![/h2]
[h3]I'm pleased to inform you that the game is released on February 27 at 7:00 AM CET[/h3]

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
[h3]I would also like to thank all of you for the positive reception of the game and for the large number of additions to wish lists. Thank you![/h3]

notes.title: Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/cJHpDv9gRN][img]https://i.imgur.com/3lyVo1H.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Hello everyone! I want to show you my progress on the game. In this little update I managed to add new unique products not yet found in any other simulator. [/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tOGDk1a.png[/img]
[h2]A lot of Whiskeys, Bourbon, Rums etc.[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/E5TTwY3.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bTH8lUW.png[/img]
[h2] Vegetables and fruits[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/l9c361J.png[/img]


[h1]Recycling bin[/h1]
[h3]Lastly, I have added a recycling bin. The bin allows you to get money back by throwing out the empty boxes from all types of products. Just touch the bin with the box and get a small chunk of money back.[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9aivqhN.png[/img]

[b][h1]Add to Wishlist on Steam[/h1][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OslJtCw.gif[/img]

[h3]Thanks for reading[/h3]
